executionHistory.summary: Authored the eight artifacts of this packet after committing the repository binding preflight for research-lab. Captured three distinct defects as three separate scopes: ingestion writing an adjusted close beside a raw low so that 71714 of 150161 rows across 245 of 293 bars files carry l > min(o, c); a committed fixture pinned to a fixed cutoff that resolves against mutable data the cron rewrites; and a boot error path whose catch never assigns state.view, so a data break presents as an unbounded hang instead of the refusal the page has already computed. Recorded in design.md that retroactively rewriting an already-published row is a provenance concern independent of the arithmetic, and that mergeRows overwrites by timestamp with no trace. Recorded in report.md that a global Playwright timeout was considered and disproven by execution at 240000 ms, and that applying one would have masked this defect rather than fixed it. Modified nothing outside this packet: data/, tests/, scripts/, research-agenda-lab.html and the BUG-011 packet are untouched, and nothing was committed. Every measurement in report.md is attributed to prior execution in this session; the agent's own execution was read-only inspection confirming each cited line number, field name and call site, including that the five failing tool-experience tests are exactly the five calling openResearchAgenda with the reversal fixture while the three calling it without the fixture pass.

executionHistory.summary: Reconciled the packet against the delivered fix. Recorded the pinned-inputs decoupling decision. Set all three scopes to Done and ticked 26 of the 27 Definition of Done items with inline evidence, each tagged executed or reported. Re-executed four checks: node scripts/selftest.mjs reporting 2534 passed and 0 failed against a 2490 pre-fix baseline; node scripts/validate-bars-coherence.mjs reporting zero violations across 292 files and 150013 rows, down from 71714 violating rows across 245 files; node scripts/validate-agenda-fixture-pin.mjs reporting every pinned row still matching at the unchanged 2026-08-14T12:00:00.000Z cutoff; and artifact-lint on this packet. All four exit 0. Verified by direct read that the COP row at 2026-08-13T13:30Z is now o=125.72000122070312 h=126.38999938964844 l=124.12000274658203 c=124.5199966430664 ac=123.6949691772461 and satisfies coherence, with the raw close restored to its pre-cron value and the adjusted close moved into ac. Verified by git that rlagenda.js and playwright.config.mjs appear nowhere in the change set, that the scope 02 commit changed zero expect() lines in the two spec files, that neither spec file contains a skip or fixme, and that the scope 03 commit touched only research-agenda-lab.html and tests/tool-experience.spec.mjs. Explained two denominator shifts rather than passing over them: 292 scanned files against 293 on disk because index.json is a manifest excluded by name, and 150013 scanned rows against a pre-fix 150161 because rows that cannot be made coherent are quarantined out of the live series and recorded per file. Left one cross-scope item unticked with an Uncertainty Declaration because the full committed Playwright suite was not run. Modified only scopes.md, report.md, state.json and uservalidation.md. Nothing was committed.
